Creamy Chavrie Green Beans
By: Corrinne
Published: Friday, March 26, 2010 - 11:44am

Ingredients




1 package (5.3oz) Basil and Roasted Garlic Chavrie® goat cheese
1 pound Cut green beans

Preparation

1 Remove Chavrie® from package in a medium sauce pot. 2 Bring to a gentle simmer. 3 Add green beans. 4 Place in a casserole dish. 5 Bake for 5-7 minutes. 6 Garnish with chopped parsley.

About


If you are planning a special dinner or having a holiday at home, these green beans are perfect for a large family. They are unique and add a zing to traditional side dishes.
